data.name: AccentColorHint
data.value: Replaces the theme's accent on buttons, links and selection.

data.name: TextSizeHint
data.value: Makes text larger or smaller across the app.

data.name: MyThemesHint
data.value: Create your own theme from the colors on screen, or import one that was shared with you.

data.name: ScopeHint_All
data.value: Settings shared by all your devices. Pick a type of device to give it a different theme, text size or corners.

data.name: ScopeHint_Shared
data.value: No separate settings for {0} yet: they use the shared settings. Change a setting below to set them apart.

data.name: ScopeHint_Own
data.value: Separate settings for {0}. Your other devices keep theirs.

data.name: ServerScopeHint_All
data.value: Presentation shared by every device. Pick a type of device to give it a different one.

data.name: ServerScopeHint_Shared
data.value: No separate presentation for {0} yet: they use the shared one. Change a setting below to set them apart.

data.name: ServerScopeHint_Own
data.value: Separate presentation for {0}. The other devices keep the shared one or their own.

data.name: ScopePreviewNote
data.value: Preview: this device goes back to its own settings when you leave the page.

data.name: MiniPlayerHint
data.value: On desktop, tablet and TV. On a phone it stays above the bottom bar.

data.name: ServerDefaultsHint
data.value: Default presentation of the server: the one of the accounts that did not make their own settings here. They will see it the next time they start the app.

data.name: MediaPageKindHint_All
data.value: Settings shared by the pages, seasons aside. Pick a kind of page to give it its own: series that show their seasons at once, movies on a full page.

data.name: MediaPageKindHint_Shared
data.value: This kind of page follows the shared settings. Change a setting below to make it differ.

data.name: MediaPageKindHint_Own
data.value: Settings of this kind of page only. The other pages keep theirs.

data.name: MediaPageKindHint_Season
data.value: The page of a season has its own presentation: its episodes as a list or a grid. On TV, it always is a carousel.

data.name: SeasonPageHint
data.value: How the page of a season shows its episodes.

data.name: SeasonPage_List_Hint
data.value: The episodes in a list under the title of the season.

data.name: SeasonPage_Grid_Hint
data.value: The episodes as a grid of cards under the title of the season.

data.name: MediaPageHeroHint
data.value: How the artwork ends at the top of movie, series, episode and person pages.

data.name: MediaPageHero_Fade_Hint
data.value: The artwork fades into the color of the page.

data.name: MediaPageHero_Cut_Hint
data.value: The artwork stops on a clean edge, the lists start right under it.

data.name: MediaPageHero_Banner_Hint
data.value: The artwork stays in a rounded banner, like on the home page: the title and details are inside it, the rest of the page keeps its color.

data.name: MediaPageHeroSizeHint
data.value: How much of the screen the artwork and the title take. On a phone, it is the height of the artwork.

data.name: MediaPageHeroSize_Full_Hint
data.value: Immersive: the artwork and the title take the whole screen, cast, seasons and suggestions come as you scroll.

data.name: MediaPageHeroSize_Half_Hint
data.value: The artwork and the title take half of the screen, the first lists show without scrolling.

data.name: MediaPageHeroSize_Third_Hint
data.value: The artwork takes a third of the screen: the title, the details and the lists come up as high as they can.

data.name: MediaPagePosterHint
data.value: Next to the title, on movie and series pages.

data.name: MediaPageListsHint
data.value: Seasons, cast and similar titles: on one line that scrolls, or all visible in a grid.

data.name: MediaPageGridMoreHint
data.value: A "Show more" button shows the rest. Handy when the cast is long.

data.name: AudioSeekHint
data.value: The rings go around a round cover.

data.name: VideoPlayerHint
data.value: Player of the browser. Installed apps have their own player, which follows the two lines, the middle controls and the color.

data.name: VideoCenterControlsHint
data.value: Play and skip back and forward in the middle of the picture.

data.name: VideoPosterHint
data.value: At the bottom left, with the controls.

data.name: VideoLogoHint
data.value: When the movie or series has one.

data.name: VideoControlsHint
data.value: On two lines, the progress bar goes under the buttons.
